descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Vânzări cu amănuntul și Vânzări cu amănuntul de îmbrăcăminte și modă
We are looking for an IT Support Specialist who will help ensure smooth day-to-day IT operations by supporting our store and office colleagues.
 Your responsibilities: 
Provide first-line technical support to stores and office users via ticketing system and phone.
Diagnose and resolve hardware and software issues.
Install and configure IT equipment for employees.
Log and manage incidents and requests in the ITSM system.
Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to resolve complex issues.
Support users in effectively using IT tools and systems.
Maintain and update the Knowledge Base with new solutions and cases.
Ensure constant communication and follow-up with users regarding their requests.
 What we are looking for: 
 2–3 years of experience in IT support.
 Solid knowledge of: 
Computer hardware, software, operating systems, and POS systems.
ITIL Service Operations processes.
Basic networking and telecommunications.
 Intermediate+ English level. 
 Strong: 
Communication and interpersonal skills.
Problem-solving abilities.
Planning and organizational skills.
Teamwork and customer-oriented mindset.
Openness to change and a proactive attitude.
 We offer: 
A dynamic environment in a fast-growing international company.
Opportunities for learning and professional development.
Exposure to complex IT operations in the retail industry.
